briefdescription.para: Create a binary file from the given memory buffer.

detaileddescription.para: The exact type of the binary file will be inferred automatically, and the appropriate implementation selected. The context may be NULL except if the resulting file is an LLVM IR file.
The memory buffer is not consumed by this function. It is the responsibilty of the caller to free it with LLVMDisposeMemoryBuffer.
If NULL is returned, the ErrorMessage parameter is populated with the error's description. It is then the caller's responsibility to free this message by calling LLVMDisposeMessage.
The binary file does not own its backing buffer. It is the responsibilty of the caller to free it with LLVMDisposeMemoryBuffer.

briefdescription.para: Retrieves a copy of the memory buffer associated with this object file.

detaileddescription.para: The returned buffer is merely a shallow copy and does not own the actual backing buffer of the binary. Nevertheless, it is the responsibility of the caller to free it with LLVMDisposeMemoryBuffer.

briefdescription.para: Retrieve the specific type of a binary.

memberdef.argsstring: (LLVMBinaryRef BR, const char *Arch, size_t ArchLen, char **ErrorMessage)
memberdef.name: LLVMMachOUniversalBinaryCopyObjectForArch

briefdescription.para: Retrieve a copy of the section iterator for this object file.

detaileddescription.para: If there are no sections, the result is NULL.
The returned iterator is merely a shallow copy. Nevertheless, it is the responsibility of the caller to free it with LLVMDisposeSectionIterator.

briefdescription.para: Returns whether the given section iterator is at the end.
Retrieve a copy of the symbol iterator for this object file.

detaileddescription.para: If there are no symbols, the result is NULL.
The returned iterator is merely a shallow copy. Nevertheless, it is the responsibility of the caller to free it with LLVMDisposeSymbolIterator.

briefdescription.para: Returns whether the given symbol iterator is at the end.
